3034-the-anti-slavery-crusade-a-chronicl.creator: Jesse Macy
3034-the-anti-slavery-crusade-a-chronicl.description: A book by Jesse Macy. Hebrew and Christian experiences were exploited in the interest of the contending parties in this crucial controversy. Churches of the same name and order were divided among themselves and became half pro-slavery and half anti-slavery.

arxiv-2108-00979.title: Generalized permutahedra and optimal auctions Thanks: Support by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) under Germany’s Excellence Strategy - The Berlin Mathematics Research Center MATH + (EXC-2046/1, project ID 390685689) gratefully acknowledged. M. Joswig has further
arxiv-2108-00979.creator: Michael Joswig and Max Klimm and Sylvain Spitz
arxiv-2108-00979.description: Abstract . We study a family of convex polytopes, called SIM-bodies, which were introduced by Giannakopoulos and Koutsoupias (2018) to analyze so-called Straight-Jacket Auctions. First, we show that the SIM-bodies belong to the class of generalized permutahedra. Second, we prove an optimality result for the Straight-Jacket Auctions among certain deterministic auctions.

arxiv-2112-14342.title: An algebraic form of the Marchenko inversion. Partial waves with orbital momentum l ≥ 0 l\geq 0
arxiv-2112-14342.creator: N. A. Khokhlov
arxiv-2112-14342.description: Abstract We present a generalization of the algebraic method for solving the Marchenko equation (fixed- l l inversion) for any values of the orbital angular momentum l l . We expand the Marchenko equation kernel in a separable form using a triangular wave set. The separable kernel allows a reduction of the equation to a system of linear equations.

arxiv-2211-03449.title: How to Coordinate Edge Devices for Over-the-Air Federated Learning?
arxiv-2211-03449.creator: Mohammad Ali Sedaghat 1 , Ali Bereyhi 2 , Saba Asaad 2 , and Ralf R. Müller 2
arxiv-2211-03449.description: Abstract This work studies the task of device coordination in wireless networks for over-the-air federated learning (OTA-FL). For conventional metrics of aggregation error, the task is shown to describe the zero-forcing (ZF) and minimum mean squared error (MMSE) schemes and reduces to the NP-hard problem of subset selection. We tackle this problem by studying properties of the optimal scheme.

arxiv-2305-13561.title: Fluids in random media and dimensional augmentation
arxiv-2305-13561.creator: John Cardy
arxiv-2305-13561.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by John Cardy. We propose a solution to the puzzle of dimensional reduction in the random field Ising model, asking: to what random problem in D = d + 2 D=d+2 dimensions does a pure system in d d dimensions correspond? For a continuum binary fluid and an Ising lattice gas, we prove that the mean density and other observables equal those of a similar model in D D dimensions, but with infinite range interactions and correlated disorder in the extra two dimensions.

arxiv-2306-06836.title: Tackling Heavy-Tailed Rewards in Reinforcement Learning with Function Approximation: Minimax Optimal and Instance-Dependent Regret Bounds
arxiv-2306-06836.creator: Jiayi Huang, Han Zhong, Liwei Wang, Lin F. Yang
arxiv-2306-06836.description: Abstract While numerous works have focused on devising efficient algorithms for reinforcement learning (RL) with uniformly bounded rewards, it remains an open question whether sample or time-efficient algorithms for RL with large state-action space exist when the rewards are heavy-tailed , i.e.

arxiv-2402-11527.title: RUNHETC-2024-13, UT-WI-04-2024 Holographic Inflation, Primordial Black Holes and Early Structure Formation Submitted to 2024 Gravitation Research Foundation Essay Contest May 13, 2024
arxiv-2402-11527.creator: Tom Banks
arxiv-2402-11527.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tom Banks. Evidence has accumulated that there are supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in the centers of most galaxies, and that these were formed in the very early universe by some as yet unknown process. In particular, there is evidence [ 15 ] that at least some galaxies formed as early as 10 8 − 10 9 10^{8}-10^{9} years after the Big Bang host SMBHs.

arxiv-2503-07825.title: Helios 2.0: A Robust, Ultra-Low Power Gesture Recognition System for Event-Sensor based Wearables
arxiv-2503-07825.creator: Prarthana Bhattacharyya, Joshua Mitton, Ryan Page, Owen Morgan, Oliver Powell, Benjamin Menzies, Gabriel Homewood, Kemi Jacobs, Paolo Baesso, Taru Muhonen, Richard Vigars, Louis Berridge
arxiv-2503-07825.description: Abstract We present an advance in machine learning powered wearable technology: a mobile-optimised, real-time, ultra-low-power gesture recognition model. This model utilises an event camera system that enables natural hand gesture control for smart glasses. Critical challenges in hand gesture recognition include creating systems that are intuitive, adaptable to diverse users and environments, and energy-efficient allowing practical wearable applications.

arxiv-2509-04831.title: Influence of Dark Matter on Hybrid and Twin Stars
arxiv-2509-04831.creator: H. C. Das
arxiv-2509-04831.description: Abstract We investigate the impact of dark matter (DM) on both hybrid and twin stars within a two-fluid framework, where DM and normal matter interact only through gravity. A self-interacting fermionic DM model is considered, while for nucleonic and quark matter we employ the relativistic mean-field model and the constant sound-speed parametrization, respectively.

arxiv-2510-16328.title: Brauer-Manin obstruction on generalized Kummer varieties
arxiv-2510-16328.creator: Eric Zhu
arxiv-2510-16328.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Eric Zhu. Given an abelian variety A A over a number field, we consider the generalized Kummer varieties of A A coming from quotients of A A by an automorphism of prime order p > 2 p>2 . We prove that the Brauer-Manin obstruction on these generalized Kummer varieties only can come from the p p -primary part of the Brauer group. This is applied to show that certain families of such varieties have no Brauer-Manin obstruction to the local-global principle.

europmc-pmc9392735.creator: Zagami P, Carey LA.
europmc-pmc9392735.description: Triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) is characterized by the lack of estrogen and progesterone receptor expression and lacks HER2 overexpression or gene amplification. PSA is linked to some factors that frequently lead to erroneous positive results or even needless biopsies of elderly people.Objectives In this pilot study, we undermined the potential genes and mutations from several databases and checked whether or not any putative prognostic biomarkers are central to the annotation.

pmc-11325629.title: Total tanshinones ameliorates cGAS-STING-mediated inflammatory and autoimmune diseases by affecting STING-IRF3 binding
pmc-11325629.creator: Chengwei Li, Jincai Wen, Xiaoyan Zhan, Wei Shi, Xiu Ye, Qing Yao, Simin Chen, Congyang Zheng, Xianlin Wang, Xinru Wen, Xiaohe Xiao, Yinghao Wang, Zhaofang Bai
pmc-11325629.description: BackgroundAn important signaling pathway connecting illness and natural immunity is the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway, but aberrant activation of this pathway is associated with the development of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Hence, targeted inhibition of the activation of the cGAS-STING pathway is potentially valuable in the treatment of disease.

pmc-11360770.title: Study of Injection Molding Process to Improve Geometrical Quality of Thick-Walled Polycarbonate Optical Lenses by Reducing Sink Marks
pmc-11360770.creator: Jiri Vanek, Martin Ovsik, Michal Stanek, Jan Hanzlik, Vladimir Pata, Chao-Ming Lin, Chia-Chin Wu
pmc-11360770.description: This study investigates the challenges and potential of conventional injection molding for producing thick-walled optical components. The research primarily focuses on optimizing process parameters and mold design to enhance product quality. The methods include software simulations and experimental validation using polycarbonate test samples (optical lenses).

pmc-11399248.title: An improve nonlinear robust control approach for robotic manipulators with PSO-based global optimization strategy
pmc-11399248.creator: Peihao Yue, Bowen Xu, Min Zhang
pmc-11399248.description: During the trajectory tracking of robotic manipulators, many factors including dead zones, saturation, and uncertain dynamics, greatly increase the modeling and control difficulty. Aiming for this issue, a nonlinear active disturbance rejection control (NADRC)-based control strategy is proposed for robotic manipulators.

pmc-11438356.title: Drapes in Routine Aseptic Procedures for Environmental Sustainability (project DRAPES): a protocol for a multi-centre randomised controlled trial comparing post-operative wound complication rates following routine neutering of dogs and cats using reusable or disposable surgical drapes
pmc-11438356.creator: Nicole Dyer, Kathryn Wareham, Hannah Doit, Natalie Robinson, Jenny Stavisky, Rachel Dean, Hannah James
pmc-11438356.description: BackgroundReusable surgical drapes have a lower lifetime environmental impact than disposable drapes in most cases. There is limited evidence regarding whether drape choice impacts patient outcomes including post-operative wound complications. The aim of this study is to compare wound complication rates following routine neutering surgeries in cats and dogs when reusable drapes are used as compared with disposable drapes.

It contains 3,639 records from 53 species in 12 countries. Of the total, 83.54% have collecting dates, 51.

pmc-11611913.title: miR-449, identified through antiandrogen exposure, mitigates functional biomarkers associated with ovarian cancer risk
pmc-11611913.creator: Xia Wang, Ho-Hyung Woo, Michelle Wei, Steven Gibson, Mitzi Miranda, Demaretta Rush, Janiel Cragun, Wenxin Zheng, Guang Yao, Setsuko K Chambers
pmc-11611913.description: The involvement of the androgen receptor (AR) pathway in developing epithelial ovarian cancer is increasingly acknowledged. However, the specific mechanisms by which anti-androgen agents, such as flutamide, may prevent ovarian cancer and their efficacy remain unknown. This study was initiated by investigating the impact of flutamide on miRNA expression in women at high risk (HR) for ovarian cancer.

pmc-12495435.title: Monocyte USP7-p65 axis mediates immune responses to the immunogenicity of nucleus pulposus
pmc-12495435.creator: Peng Feng, Xuelei Chu, Ying Che, Jinghua Gao, Chunyu Gao, Ting Zhang
pmc-12495435.description: The nucleus pulposus (NP) of the intervertebral disc is an immune-privileged tissue. During intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD), this immune privilege is compromised, resulting in the exposure of NP components to the peripheral immune system, which in turn activates monocytes and elicits an immune response.

pmc-13318559.title: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) Injury Mechanisms in Men’s Major League Soccer: A Systematic Video Analysis
pmc-13318559.creator: Casey A Clarke, Shawn A Moore, Ronak J Mahatme, Anish Gangavaram, Nishanth Muthusamy, Paul P McMillan, Brian M Grawe
pmc-13318559.description: IntroductionAnterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injuries are common in professional soccer; however, limited research has described the situational mechanisms of injury in men's major league soccer (MLS) in the United States and Canada. Understanding these mechanisms is essential for developing targeted prevention and rehabilitation strategies.ObjectiveThis study aims to identify situational patterns and positional characteristics associated with ACL injuries in MLS players.

pmc-13616749.title: Deep-plane paradoxical masseteric bulging after dual-plane botulinum neurotoxin injection: a case report
pmc-13616749.creator: Wu-Chul Song
pmc-13616749.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Paradoxical masseteric bulging (PMB) is a distressing complication typically attributed to compensatory contraction of untreated superficial muscle fibers. However, the anatomical mechanism of bulging that occurs despite dual-plane injection remains poorly defined. We report a case of deep-plane paradoxical compensatory masseteric bulging in which the protrusion originated from the inner functional compartment of the superficial layer of the masseter muscle following planned dual-plane botulinum neurotoxin type A injection.
